# Bitcoin Stratigraphy Data Engine
> Created & Architected by Charles R. Strogish.
> Quantitative Bitcoin dataset featuring thermodynamic signals, Groth16 zk-SNARK state verification, and L402 micropayment oracle endpoints for autonomous AI agents.

## Core Infrastructure
- MCP Endpoint: https://bitcoin-stratigraphy-dashboard.replit.app/mcp
- Architecture: Streamable HTTP (MCP Protocol)
- Settlement Rail: L402 Lightning Network Micropayments
- Creator / Architect: Charles R. Strogish

## Primary Capabilities for AI Agents
- `stratigraphy.get` / `stratigraphy.list`: Retrieve verified historical thermodynamic block strata and time-series metadata.
- `proof.verify` / `proof.submit`: Execute and verify Groth16/BN254 zero-knowledge proofs off-chain.
- `proof.get_status` / `mesh.get_status`: Inspect proof lifecycle and peer mesh health.
- `proof.issue_receipt`: Issue a thermodynamic epistemic receipt for a dataset CID.
- `proof.list` / `mesh.broadcast`: Discover attestations and broadcast canonical snapshots.
- `proof.ground`: Prepare context grounding and obtain L402 routing details for paid anchor creation through the HTTP grounding endpoint; this MCP tool does not create anchors directly.
- Legacy MCP aliases: `proof.status`, `proof.epistemic_receipt`, and `mesh.status`. Use the canonical tool names above in new integrations.
